correctness.rationale: The prefix/suffix positioning argument proves that every cover uses exactly one or two markers and each marker count admits only one candidate. The exact iff gap inequalities follow from available occurrences and interval coverage. Disjoint integer-parameter bijections give A,B and C, with inclusion-exclusion and rational-function pole orders yielding the full all-length spectrum and density. Standalone direct coverage tests verify 14950 words through length 25, independent coefficient constructions through degree 65. Risks: endpoint or pole errors, checked by two-direction proofs and independent diagnostics.

value.rationale: Proper covers quantify nontrivial repetition. Three is the first positive Hamming weight that can admit two proper quasiperiods; the result solves its exact all-length structural classification and number-of-cover distribution. The rational functions reveal positive limiting quasiperiodicity probability 1/90 and a 1/(12n) rarity law for double covers, information not contained in unrestricted or algorithmic studies.
